evidence.title: GitHub - flixlix/shadcn-date-picker: Advanced date picker with range selection, year and month selection, and more. · GitHub

name: Shadcn Date Picker
summary: Advanced date picker for shadcn/ui with single-date and range selection plus year and month navigation.
description: A custom shadcn component that offers a more advanced alternative to the default shadcn date picker, built on react-day-picker v9. It ships a basic single-date picker and a date-range picker, both with year navigation via the month label, and installs with the shadcn CLI.
contains: year and month navigation (click the month label)
